review.why: Reference for building apps on the vendor's model API: surfaces, models, SDK patterns, caching, agents, migration and cost subcommands.
review.summary: Routes a request to the right surface (single call, workflow, agent, managed agents), detects the project language and points to per-language guides. It carries current model ids, quick references for thinking, caching, streaming, tools and cloud providers, an API-drift table, and subcommands for migration, prompt audit, SDK upgrade, cost optimization, evals and hill-climbing.
strengths: Warns that remembered API shapes are stale and gives a drift table
Refuses to guess SDK usage: code must come from the bundled files or live docs
Costly subcommands ask for scope and approval first
cautions: Huge: about 105,000 characters and fifty-odd bundled files, most not read here
Only for the vendor's own SDK, and it refuses to put those calls into non-vendor code
Very broad trigger text that fires on any mention of the vendor or of LLM tasks
